messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — GPU_POOL_EXHAUSTION on gpu-prod-eu-1 · queue growth detected >90% · autoscaler requests queued · paging @ella-oncall :rotating_light:
ella-oncall: I'm on it. Acknowledge pager, assembling triage now. Anyone see recent rollout to batching/cache?
sam-prod: seeing elevated 429s on /v1/generate and 503s from inference runtime. Latency spiking to 7-15s. Customers A and C reporting timeouts.
maggie-sre: autoscaler metric shows desired_nodes=72, current_nodes=48 (hard_limit=max_nodes config), scale requests throttled by scale-policy. Cloud quota not the issue — it's our configured cap.
ryan-eng: are the pods healthy? Any hotshard or eviction logs?
alice-ps: quick heads-up — we pushed continuous-batching change ~2h ago in canary and then promoted: batch_window 20ms -> 50ms, prefix_cache_ttl 60s -> 15s to reduce memory footprint.
sam-prod: that's likely it. Prefix cache TTL down -> cache miss rate jumped -> KV recompute per request -> more GPU ops per request -> throughput collapse. Queue builds and autoscaler tries to react but hits hard_limit.
ella-oncall: good catch. Can someone post cache miss graphs and queue length? Need numbers to quantify customer impact.
maggie-sre: attaching recent metrics snapshot (excerpt):
```
time, queue_len, prefix_cache_miss_pct, gpu_util
13:40, 1200, 72, 96
13:45, 1800, 85, 99
13:50, 2300, 92, 100
13:55, 2100, 88, 100
```
We hit 100% GPU util and queue kept growing while autoscaler queued scale-up requests.
ryan-eng: any deploy-bot activity?
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T12:45 promoted: service/continuous-batching v2.1 -> prod (alice-ps).
ella-oncall: decision matrix: 1) roll back batching change (safe, quick) 2) temporarily raise max_nodes cap (needs infra approval) 3) divert low-priority traffic to fallback model 4) customer comms. We should do rollback + diversion now.
alice-ps: rolling back continuous-batching changes now. Reverting batch_window and prefix_cache_ttl to previous values. Will push rollback flag to prod via canary -> global.
infra-ops: raising max_nodes by 12 will need 15m and confirmation of capacity. I can try to push soft-limit to allow immediate 12 nodes if needed.
sam-prod: while rollback propagates, can we enable model-fallback routing for non-SLAs? e.g., route /generate for plan=free -> model-small fallback. That will relieve pressure.
maggie-sre: creating temporary route rule: routing-safety toggle: route_low_priority=true. Pushing now.
ella-oncall: execute rollback first. Alice, confirm when rollback hits control plane. Maggie, confirm routing toggle. Infra, let us know if soft-limit increased.
alice-ps: rollback triggered: `kubectl -n inference set image deployment/continuous-batcher continuous-batcher=continuous-batcher:v2.0` 
deploy-bot: rollback initiated by alice-ps at 2026-03-15T13:02, canary -> 30% -> 100% (progressing).
maggie-sre: routing toggle applied: low-priority traffic now routed to fallback-model-sm.
ella-oncall: checking customer impact table — latency for tiered customers:
- enterprise customers: 3-5s elevated latency, some 429s (5% of requests)
- free tier: redirected; latency stable
- embeddings route: affected 10% increased p99
sam-prod: we should notify ops/sales for customers with SLA impacts. I'll draft a short note.
infra-ops: soft-limit increased from 48 -> 60 nodes (temporary) to allow drain while rollback finishes. Cloud teams confirmed capacity.
ryan-eng: any signs of cache warmup after rollback? Graphs show prefix_cache_miss_pct falling: 92 -> 45 over 10 minutes. queue_len dropping: 2300 -> 900. Good.
maggie-sre: GPUs un-saturated: util dipping back to 70-85%. Autoscaler now scaling down desired_nodes -> 56 -> 50 as backlog clears.
ella-oncall: excellent. Keep monitoring for 30m. Sam, send comms to CS with ETA to full recovery ~20-30m. Add postmortem owners.
sam-prod: sent CS note: "We experienced elevated latency and throttling due to a recent batching/prefix-cache config change. Immediate rollback and routing mitigations applied. Impact mostly to high-throughput routes; we're monitoring. Will follow with postmortem."
alice-ps: confirmed rollback fully rolled out at 2026-03-15T13:18.
ella-oncall: last checks: queue_len 420, prefix_cache_miss 12%, gpu_util 65. No new 5xxs. Closing pager in 30m if stable.
ella-oncall: postmortem owners: alice-ps (triggering deploy rollback), maggie-sre (mitigation + routing), ryan-eng (autoscaler hard_limit review), infra-ops (scale cap process).
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigations applied. Monitoring for 30m.
ella-oncall: TL;DR: root cause = continuous-batching config change (increased batch_window + reduced prefix_cache_ttl) -> large increase in prefix cache misses -> lower throughput -> queue growth -> autoscaler hit configured hard_limit -> partial customer impact. Remediation: immediate rollback + route diversion + temporary scale cap bump. Follow-up: postmortem + safer rollout checklist for batching/prefix cache changes (include load-test sim >2x traffic, canary metrics on prefix_cache_miss).
ryan-eng: agree. Also: consider autoscaler behavior when desired_nodes > hard_limit: surface alert earlier and auto-deprioritize non-SLA routes before hitting cap.
ella-oncall: thanks team. I'll close thread if stable at 13:30.
infra-ops: confirmed soft-limit revert scheduled at 13:45 back to normal config after validation.
ella-oncall: closing: system stable, queue draining, customer impact reducing. Postmortem requested in #postmortems.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED at 2026-03-15T13:30."
